analysis: Examined three changes. (1) ProviderLoop+StartupShutdown.swift head 67-108: shutdown teardown now goes through unloadAllModelsForShutdown(). Each slot's unload runs in its own Task with a 15s bounded wait. A slot whose retirement does not finish is abandoned with a warning rather than blocking exit. performPreRegistrationShutdown (head 61) and ProviderLoop+Serve.swift head 591 both call it. Inference drain/cancel (Serve 580-585), the coordinator shutdown and the drainNativeMiMoOwners guard still run before it. Any resident slot is therefore not serving routed traffic. Residual GPU or KV data in an abandoned slot (T-028) is released at process exit; the shutdown path has no other purge. If a scheduled-window stop keeps the process alive and serving restarts in-process, an abandoned slot could remain in modelSlots. The supplied evidence does not show that restart path, so integration should confirm that serving restart cannot reuse a half-retired slot. (2) Serve.swift head 565: shutdown now also cancels and awaits the selected-model recovery task, which closes a lifecycle gap. (3) ProviderLoop+StartupPreload.swift head 304-310: after the startup preload, finishStartupPreload enqueues recovery for candidates skipped or failed for memory and for those not attempted. Self-test-failed and retired ids are not included. The gate checks Task.isCancelled, isShuttingDown and startupPreloadStopRequested, but not servingDrain.refusing or addonHoldActive. Unlike updateAggregateCapacity at line 314, it therefore relies on the recovery implementation, ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery, which was not supplied. That implementation, or ensureModelLoaded, must honor the TB-012/T-059 model-load fence during an add-on hold. It must also honor the advertised and failed-self-test refusals (isRefusedByRetirement, failedSelfTestHashes) so a retired build is not reloaded. Neither condition is verifiable here, so this is recorded as uncertainty rather than a finding. No change touches attestation, keys, encryption, A-001 plaintext handling or the authorization paths (makeRegistrationAttestationProvider is unchanged).
